purpose: Determine whether reducing RossFast certificate substeps can close or reverse the remaining performance gap to Reference Richards, without mutating production source in this workunit.

research_method.topology: coarse + first-half + second-half retained for every variant
temporary_patch_targets: CERTIFICATE_INTERNAL_SUBSTEPS in a build-directory copy of mod_rossfast_d3r_table_kernel.f90
ROSSFAST_INTERNAL_SUBSTEPS in a build-directory copy of mod_rossfast_d3r_soil_water_solver.f90

science_questions: How many of the 36 cases remain P2E10 paired-valid for K4 and K2?
Do all route-valid cases retain mass tolerance and zero retries/alternative solver calls?
How many cases have temporal_indicator <= 1.0, the actual model-certificate acceptance threshold?
What is the worst Reference discrepancy and temporal indicator for each variant?
performance_questions: For scientifically admissible variants, what is the paired solver CPU ratio versus Reference?
At which fixed candidate-step budget, if any, does RossFast become faster than Reference on the shared-host screen?

production_candidate_requires: 36/36 temporal_indicator <= 1.0 on the fixed full interval
zero internal retries and alternative solver calls in direct solver qualification

next_permitted_action: Implement temporary-build matrix harness and execute K8/K4/K2 without changing repository production source.
